blocks.text: BULUAN, Maguindanao del Sur — Maguindanao del Sur Rep. Esmael “Toto” Mangudadatu has urged a “survivor” of the 2009 Maguindanao massacre to finally speak about his ordeal, saying it is time “to bring out the truth after 17 years of silence.” At a gathering with the victims’ families on Nov. 23 here, Mangudadatu, who declined to identify the survivor, said he had kept the matter to himself for years but decided to make the appeal now rather than wait until the 20th anniversary of the massacre. He said he was unsure whether either of them would still be alive by then. […]... Keep on reading: Maguindanao massacre survivor urged to speak up after 17 years
